annotations.text:
Direction C, built out — shadcn neutral, in Geist.

The faces are embedded, so this renders in the product's real type rather than falling back to system-ui like the first pass did. Toggle dark above any artboard.

TYPE
Geist Sans + Geist Mono, the same woff2 files apps/web serves at /fonts.

Mono carries every machine value — address, commands, counts, key names — and nothing else. That line is what keeps a value from reading as a label.

STILL OPEN
· Your display serif is Bitter (loaded from Google), so it isn't embedded here — direction C doesn't use it.
· The toolbar that opens this is still the old dark bar; it needs to become part of this system.
· Anything on these three you want changed before I build it in code.
